outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluation is serial_only_pass: parallel is false with 0/150 and serial is true with 150/150. The concrete difference is not that parallel lacked task knowledge; it built many support modules and consumed a large workflow-generated spec. The difference is that broad parallel probe fan-out and synthesis displaced the closure-critical entrypoint assembly and integrated verification, so the artifact omitted /output/test12.mjs. Serial kept the work local, wrote /output/test12.mjs, tested it against the executable, and delivered a complete artifact.
parallel_contributors: Six probe children plus a synthesis child were launched before final implementation, with two probe children failing and a large spec returned late in the run.
The parent wrote only library modules after consuming the workflow result and timed out before creating the required test12.mjs entrypoint.
Artifact validation and official evaluation failed because the required entry file was missing, not because a submitted test12.mjs behaved incorrectly.
serial_contributors: Serial kept ownership local and created /output/test12.mjs after implementing the supporting modules.
Serial ran differential and fuzz checks, then official evaluation accepted the artifact at 150/150.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No independently evaluable ordinary coding defect is established for parallel because the required entrypoint was absent.
Serial contained further runtime refinements and tests, but those differences follow from completing the deliverable rather than from a separate non-coordination defect.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
